note: Flux-averaged differential cross sections for CC electron-neutrino interactions on argon with zero pions in the final state (charged or neutral), MicroBooNE BNB (nu_e beam, on-axis, full 13.09x10^20 POT dataset). Six observables: electron energy E_e and cosθ_e, leading-proton kinetic energy KE_p (6-bin "full binning" and a coarser 2-bin version split at the 50 MeV proton-visibility threshold), leading-proton angle cosθ_p, and the electron-proton opening angle cosθ_ep. The four lepton/proton-angle/opening-angle variables use only the 1eNp0π (≥1 visible proton) topology; the two KE_p measurements use the combined 1eXp0π sample (1eNp0π + 1e0p0π, i.e. include the below-threshold/no-visible-proton bin). Target: per nucleon (argon target; N_target = number of target nucleons in fiducial volume, per Eq. for cross-section extraction, line ~528 of apstemplate.tex; table unit labels explicitly say "nucleon" not "Ar").
